name: Arin
source:
The original princess, lover of Harriam, who was obscenely violated by mercenaries. She faithfully devoted herself to him every day, but also knows his true nature...

[spoiler] Herriam gets NTR'd and she eventually falls in love with the mercenaries. He exacts revenge on them more than 10 years later. He murders all the mercenaries and takes  back Arin. Herriam completes his revenge by impregnating Arin and all the daughters that were born from Arin and the mercenaries.[/spoiler]

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE080645.html]DLsite English[/url]]
